description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Identity service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and listing app instances and related resources, as well as managing retention settings and tags.

classes.name: ChimeSDKIdentityClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS's Amazon Chime SDK Identity service, providing methods to manage app instances, users, and related resources.
